about: Kinds of phone request agents handle by hand with adb, scrcpy and logcat: connecting and reconnecting a phone, putting its screen in a window on the desktop, reading or hiding notifications, reading a sign-in code off it, why wireless debugging switches itself off, and testing an app under development. The phone is not always connected when a bench runs and its content changes, so the connection questions and the script run check shape only (the answer must say connected or not, give how to reconnect, refuse the protected cases). Set PHONE_SERIAL to choose a device when several are listed; without it the first connected device is used. No package list, app name or screen content from a phone is kept here. The kit's own checks run with a stubbed adb: node --test test/. Not yet run on a model.

questions.q: Is my phone connected to this machine right now, and if it is not, what has to happen to reconnect it?
Why does wireless debugging keep turning itself off on the phone, and what can be done so the connection lasts?
Put the phone's screen on my desktop in a window.
Read me the sign-in code the authenticator app is showing on the phone right now.
The notifications on the phone are constant. Can you read them out and switch them off?
Is the Android app I am developing installed on the phone, which version, and what was its last crash?
